newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares rise above 2,700 after German data.
newsitem.headline: French shares rise above 2,700 after German data.

text.p: French shares rose to above the 2,700 level on the back of weaker-than-expected German unemployment data and comments by Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer that conditions will improve in the labour market. U.S. May jobs data due at 1230 GMT.
* CAC-40 index up 13.71, or 0.51 percent, at 2,704.56 at 0906 GMT
* CAC-40 June futures 2,686 vs 2,685 at Thursday's close.
* SGS-Thomson, down 4.90 percent at 447.90 francs after profit warning.
* Pinault-Printemps up 3.70 percent at 2,635 after general meeting on Thursday. Brokers Ferri said the group had had an excellent start of the year.
* GAN, up 2.48 percent at 119.70, said it had sold 1.5 million shares in Total, which up 2.19 percent at 559.
* Pernod, up 2.68 percent at 303, has no comment on report it to buy Spain's Larios for 1.4 billion francs. * Lyonnaise des Eaux, down 0.91 percent at 547 francs, said signed Djakarta water contract.
